ordering: Written before development selection or confirmation results
offering: Hypothetical physically qualified passive four-event chronology device, exact order recoverable after one erased readout
evidence_boundary: No physical device, acceptance, buyer, earned revenue or passed novelty gate exists; all commercial inputs are explicit assumptions
cash_timing: 12 equal production months plus month13 collection/warranty runoff; deposit is unearned until same-month acceptance; reserves and warranty liabilities are excluded from available cash; revolving credit fills deficits and is repaid from excess cash
research_finance_assumption: Half average R&D deployment over the assumed development duration at the configured finance rate; charged once in A
selection_rule: Select active price/payment policy by mean qualified operating profit on development worlds; select launch versus HOLD by q times that mean minus E-no-benefit central R&D; tie prefers lower offered price then policy name
confirmation_rule: Freeze prices before independent-seed 512-world confirmation; preserve every active-offer world even when HOLD selected; report 5th/95th scenario spread, never empirical confidence intervals
qualification_rule: In addition to q-weighted expected profit, retain each world's sampled common physical-qualification failure/success; failures incur A research cost and no operating revenue
admission: Actual decision remains HOLD because physical qualification and novelty have not passed, regardless of hypothetical economics
